Another Quake 3 remake, '''Grim Dungeons Revisited''' created from scratch by {{player|Muff1n|flag=se}} in 2011. He tried to collab with, or atleast continue building upon, {{player|Anni|flag=de}}´s initial versions, but it was never meant to be. 

In 2020 the map was featured in [[QuakeWorld AllStars 2020]].
